Images.Caption: Two fighters face off in a dramatic battle scene, with Jago glowing with energy facing Saberwulf in a detailed arena.
Close-up of the menacing, horned demon fighter, Gargos, with glowing eyes and crossed arms, set against a cosmic background.
Two monstrous fighters, one Glacius ice red and crystalline versus wood Glacius with tree- thick limbs, clash in a snowy, icy arena with shattered ice flying between them.
Two fighters battle in a dark, industrial arena, Maya wielding a curved blade and Mira unleashing a splash of black energy.
Two muscular Native American brothers Thunder and Eagle battle on a rocky mountain stage, with glowing effects and dramatic skies in the background.
Eagle with a quiver of blue arrows draws his bow, with his mechanical blue bird soaring in a dramatic, stormy sky.
General RAAM of the Locust Horde wielding a large blade stands in a dark, cavernous arena with dramatic lighting and an ornate throne in the background.
Sabrewulf faces off against Sadira, who is sitting on webs in a cavernous arena.
Two fighters face off in a gritty, high-tech environment; Orchid stands beside The Firecat, while Jago poses confidently with crossed arms and ornate armor.
The undead pirate Spinal wielding a glowing cutlass and shield, standing in a dark, ruined ship environment with green light.

Two monstrous fighters face off in a dark, eerie battleground under a crescent moon; Eyedol is dressed as a mummy with a pumpkin head wielding a staff, while Gargos has wing incorporated into his clown outfit.
Two fighters, TJ Combo in athletic gear and Fulgore with glowing blades, battle in a high-tech industrial arena with sparks and energy effects.
Gargos has Jago by the throat in a detailed, mystical temple setting.
Two fighters battle on a wooden platform in a gritty urban environment, Kan-Ra wrapped in bandages attacking TJ Combo.
Riptor in her cheerleading outfit faces off against Battletoads Rash wearing a Rarewear hood and yellow shorts in a gritty urban arena.
A dynamic fighting scene between Maya in her day of the dead outfit and Spinal in his gladiator garb with a sword and shield, set in a lush jungle environment near a river.
Kan-Ra faces off against Aganos, the large, moss-covered golem in a mystical, ancient stone chamber.

The Reanimated Shadow Lord Eyedol, a two-headed, horned demon with glowing eyes and magical energy emanating from its faces, standing in a dark, ancient stone chamber with mystical symbols and a glowing blue portal on the wall.
The genetically engineered bioweapon known as Riptor, with glowing claws and tail stands in a rocky, post-apocalyptic environment with wreckage and fire in the background.
The spirit guardian Shin Hisako in a tattered kimono with long black hair stands in the misty Village of Whispers.
Battletoads Rash delivers a powerful kick to the flaming Cinder in a high-tech, lava-filled arena.
The Shadow Lord Gargos with large, tattered wings floats in space in front of Earth, surrounded by purple lightning and cosmic clouds.
ARIA, Advanced Robotics Intelligence Architecture.  The world's first artificial super intelligence.  Stands with glowing blue accents and mechanical drones in a high-tech environment.
ARIA and Fulgore battle in a high-tech arena with glowing holographic displays.
Close-up of the Arbiter with a glowing energy sword in a ruined arena setting.

Two detailed, monstrous fighters face off in the ruined Arena of Judgement, the 
 armored Arbiter with energy sword and Glacius in green.
Kim Wu in a vibrant costume summons glowing Dragon Spirits in a detailed urban street market setting.
Kim Wu in purple costume performing a glowing yellow energy attack in a neon-lit urban street market.
The muscular fighter Tusk, wielding a large ornate sword stands in a snowy shipwreck environment.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: Celebrate 10 years of Killer Instinct, the legendary fighting game series for Xbox and PC. The Killer Instinct Anniversary Edition includes all 29 Fighters and all premium content ever released for Killer Instinct. Unleash your killer instinct in stunning 4K resolution and 60 FPS on Xbox Series X and compatible PCs, with improved matchmaking, balance updates, and more. Whether you're a veteran or a newcomer, you'll find plenty of challenges and rewards in the single-player modes, online multiplayer, and cross-play with Windows 11 PC. Don't miss this opportunity to join the ultimate fight club and prove yourself as the supreme champion of Killer Instinct!
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Killer Instinct is the ultimate fighting game for Xbox!  Experience 4K visuals and 60 FPS on Xbox Series X and Compatible PCs. Enjoy improved matchmaking and cross-play with Windows 11 PC. Fight on!
